_readme: Template. Copy one block into configs/moderation.json, replace the chat id with the real -100... id, then flip dry_run to false ONLY for that chat once the dry-run log looks right. Every key is optional except the chat id; unknown keys are dropped and missing keys fall back to the safe defaults in src/rugmunchbot/moderation/policy.py. Hot reload: configs/moderation.json is re-read on mtime, no restart.

community._readme: Optional MissRose/Heimdall-style extras. Every switch is OFF by default; enable one at a time. Notes/filters/gbans/schedules persist in Redis only when RUGMUNCH_MODERATION_REDIS=1, else process memory.
community.welcome_text: Welcome {name} - read the pins, never share a seed phrase.

guard._readme: Channel-entrance + anti-abuse knobs (see moderation/guard_settings.py). Omit any key to inherit the env/default. quarantine_score: risk at/above this holds the join instead of admitting it to the captcha. new_account_id_min: Telegram user-id watermark used as an account-age proxy (Bot API exposes no creation date). raid_*/flood_*: sliding-window burst detection; while a raid holds, unverified senders are contained and EVERYONE can /modraid off to release it. quarantine_channel_id: private admin channel that receives each hold + its action_id.

-1001234567890.appeal_note: Think this is wrong? DM the bot /appeal with this message id.
